# `service` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "service" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/service/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique service id, e.g. "kettleback-carrying-fee". Stable once shipped. |
| `notes` | string | required | Who sells it, why this price, for owner review. |
| `providerNpcId` | ref → creature | required | The NPC creature who provides the service. |
| `name` | string | required | What a listing shows, e.g. "Carrying fee". |
| `price` | integer 1–100000 | — | Fixed crowns. Give exactly one of `price` and `priceFormula`. |
| `priceFormula` | object | — | A price that eases with the provider’s disposition toward the player. |
| `priceFormula.base` | integer 1–100000 | required | Crowns at disposition 0 or below. |
| `priceFormula.floor` | integer 1–100000 | required | The least it ever costs. |
| `priceFormula.perDisposition` | number > 0 ≤ 1000 | required | Crowns knocked off per point of disposition above 0 (rounded down). |
| `conditions` | list of object | `[]` | Conditions (logic DSL) that must all hold to buy; none = always. |
| `conditions[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `showWhenLocked` | boolean | `false` | Unmet conditions: `true` lists the service locked, `false` hides it. |
| `effects` | list of object | `[]` | Effects (logic DSL) applied with the payment, all or nothing. None = a pure fee. `purchaseService` is not allowed here. |
| `effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
